words.definition: not able to be trusted or depended on
words.example: We switched suppliers because the old one had an unreliable delivery schedule.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們換了供應商，因為原本那家的出貨時程不可靠。

words.example: The new product line has received widespread acclaim from reviewers.
words.exampleTranslation: 這條新產品線得到了評論者的廣泛讚譽。

words.definition: continuing for a long time or recurring frequently
words.example: The department has a chronic shortage of qualified technicians.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個部門長期缺乏合格的技術人員。

words.example: Customer satisfaction began to deteriorate after the price increase.
words.exampleTranslation: 調漲價格後，顧客滿意度開始惡化。

words.definition: to look or seem like someone or something else
words.example: The new interface closely resembles the one used by our competitor.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個新介面跟我們競爭對手用的非常相似。

words.example: Unauthorized access to the payroll system will be reported to security.
words.exampleTranslation: 未經授權存取薪資系統的行為將會被通報給安全部門。

words.definition: to break a rule, law, or agreement
words.example: Sharing client data with a third party would violate the contract.
words.exampleTranslation: 把客戶資料分享給第三方會違反合約規定。

words.definition: to disconnect a device by removing its plug
words.example: Please unplug the projector before you leave the conference room.
words.exampleTranslation: 離開會議室前請把投影機的插頭拔掉。

words.definition: a meeting held between people in different locations using video technology
words.example: The quarterly review will be held as a videoconference this time.
words.exampleTranslation: 這次的季度檢討會議會用視訊會議的方式進行。
